description: Send or update a push notification on an ntfy topic. Topics are created on first publish — treat the topic name as a secret because anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe. Set `sequence_id` to update a previously-published message; otherwise the call creates a new one. Use `ntfy_search_emoji_tags` to look up emoji short codes for `tags`. A publish carrying `email`, `call`, or a `broadcast`/`http` action button reaches beyond the notification drawer, so that call always asks the user to confirm the specific target first and comes back requesting that input rather than a result; reissue the same call with the answer attached to send it. Declining fails the call with `consent_declined`. A plain notification publishes on the first call.

actions.description: Up to 3 action buttons. Discriminated by `action` (`view`, `broadcast`, `http`, `copy`).

items.description: A single action button. Discriminated by `action` — `view`, `broadcast`, `http`, or `copy`.

oneOf.description: Open a URL or app when the button is tapped.

clear.description: Dismiss the notification after the button is tapped.

label.description: Button label shown in the notification.

url.description: URL opened on tap — http(s) opens the browser; mailto:, geo:, ntfy://, twitter:// open registered apps.

oneOf.description: Send an Android broadcast intent (Tasker/MacroDroid integrations).

clear.description: Dismiss the notification after the button is tapped.

extras.description: String extras passed alongside the broadcast.

label.description: Button label shown in the notification.

oneOf.description: Fire an HTTP request (default POST) when the button is tapped.

clear.description: Dismiss the notification only when the request succeeds.

headers.description: Headers attached to the HTTP request.

label.description: Button label shown in the notification.

method.description: HTTP method — defaults to POST when omitted.

url.description: Absolute URL the HTTP request is sent to.

oneOf.description: Copy a value to the clipboard when the button is tapped.

clear.description: Dismiss the notification after the button is tapped.

label.description: Button label shown in the notification.

value.description: Text copied to the device clipboard on tap.

attach.description: External attachment URL (absolute). ntfy fetches it on the recipient device — host the file somewhere reachable first; no local file uploads.

base_url.description: Override the configured `NTFY_BASE_URL` for this call — an absolute `http(s)://` URL. When the override differs from the configured base URL, server-configured auth credentials are NOT forwarded.

cache.description: Set false to skip server-side caching. Live subscribers still receive the message but `ntfy_fetch_messages` will not see it. Sent as `X-Cache: no`.

call.description: Trigger a voice call — `+CCNNNNNNNNNN` or `'yes'` for the authenticated user's first verified number. Requires an authenticated ntfy account; ntfy.sh limits this to Pro plans.

click.description: URL opened when the notification is tapped — http(s), mailto:, geo:, ntfy://, etc.

delay.description: Schedule delivery for later. Accepts a duration (`30m`, `2h`, `1d`), a Unix timestamp, or natural-language time (`tomorrow, 10am`, `Tuesday, 7am`). Server-enforced 10s minimum, 3-day maximum.

email.description: Forward to email — an address (`phil@example.com`) or `'yes'` to use the authenticated user's first verified address.

filename.description: Overrides the attachment's display filename in the client.

firebase.description: Set false to skip Firebase Cloud Messaging. Delays Android delivery up to 15 min unless the recipient enabled instant delivery. Sent as `X-Firebase: no`.

icon.description: Absolute JPEG/PNG icon URL shown next to the message body. Cached for 24h.

markdown.description: Render the message body as Markdown (web app only; mobile renders plain text).

message.description: Notification body, ≤4096 bytes (not characters — accented letters, CJK, and emoji cost 2–4 bytes each). Empty/missing is replaced server-side with the literal `triggered`; pass real content even for ping-style alerts.

priority.description: Notification priority — 1=min, 2=low, 3=default, 4=high, 5=max/urgent. Server defaults to 3 when omitted.

sequence_id.description: Update or replace a previously-published message instead of creating a new one. Same identifier used by `ntfy_manage_message`. 1–64 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags. Strings matching ntfy emoji short codes render as emojis prepended to the title; others render as a tag list. Use `ntfy_search_emoji_tags` to discover short codes.

title.description: Notification title. Defaults to the topic URL on the recipient device.

topic.description: Target topic. Required unless `NTFY_DEFAULT_TOPIC` is configured. Treat the topic name as a secret — anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe.

attachment.description: Attachment metadata echoed by the server when present on the publish.

expires.description: Unix seconds when the hosted attachment ages out — absent for externally-hosted attachments.

size.description: Attachment size in bytes — present only when ntfy hosted the upload.

type.description: Mime type — present only when ntfy hosted the upload.

click.description: Echo of the input click URL; absent when not set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `consent_declined`: The publish carried an out-of-band side effect (`email`, `call`, or a `broadcast`/`http` action button), the user was asked to confirm it, and declined, cancelled, or answered with a payload that did not parse. `forbidden_topic`: Auth required for the target topic. `rate_limited`: Upstream returned 429 after retries were exhausted. `payload_too_large`: Upstream returned 413, or rejected the request as too large — the message body or attachment exceeds server limits. `invalid_attachment`: ntfy rejected the `attach` URL as malformed. `unverified_contact`: `email`/`call` set but the authenticated user has no verified address/number, or auth is missing. `upstream_unreachable`: DNS, connection, or network failure reaching the ntfy server after retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

expires.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message ages out of server cache. Absent when published with `cache: false`.

id.description: Server-assigned message ID — pass back as `sequence_id` to update later.

message.description: Echo of the input message; `triggered` when the input body was empty.

priority.description: Echo of the input priority; absent when default (3).

scheduled.description: True when `delay` was set and the message is queued for later delivery.

sequence_id.description: Echo of the input `sequence_id`; absent when no `sequence_id` was supplied.

tags.description: Echo of the input tags; absent when none were set.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. For an immediate publish this is when ntfy accepted the message; when `delay` was set (`scheduled: true`) ntfy reports the scheduled delivery time instead, which is in the future.

title.description: Echo of the input title; absent when not set.

topic.description: Topic the message was published to.

url.description: Browser URL `<baseUrl>/<topic>`. Synthesized by the tool — ntfy does not return it.
